Integration domain PLT

Platform infrastructure

Each boundary defines required operations, direction and response, current implementation state, downstream consumers and the mandatory safe-failure contract.

14 contractsSource-linkedProduction boundary explicit
INT-PLT-01

Workforce identity

Also used by: LWS, admin, isolated control engine

Required external contract

Entra/Okta/AD FS/Keycloak/OpenLDAP-bridge or generic OIDC/SAML metadata/JWKS/signatures, MFA/WebAuthn/device posture, SCIM JML, group-to-role request, logout/token revoke and access-review export

Direction and response

BOTH

Current implementation boundary

Cryptographic OIDC, certified SAML-attestation boundary, scoped SCIM, exact-byte RS256/ES256 logout verification, persistent expiring conformance, durable operational workers and explicit session revocation executable; no commercial connection. IdP groups never grant canonical roles directly

Mandatory failure behavior

Requests remain tenant- and purpose-scoped with immutable correlation and idempotency evidence. Timeout, invalid signature, replay, stale schema, reconciliation break or unavailable authority cannot advance money, identity, policy or workflow state; the operation stays pending, refers or denies and opens attributable exception work.

Certification and production checklist
  • Contract, regulatory eligibility, India data location, subprocessors, audit rights and exit are approved.
  • mTLS or scoped service identity, secret rotation, callback signature and replay-window validation are certified.
  • Happy, reject, timeout, duplicate, out-of-order, partial, tamper, expiry, correction and recovery cases pass.
  • Daily control totals, provider references, acknowledgements, reconciliation breaks and operator replay are evidenced.
  • Live credentials, tenant configuration, UAT, monitoring, incident response and rollback are admitted separately from simulator evidence.
